project.title: Global Search
project.goal: Add Global Search to Basis, giving users a quick way to find content, move between views, and take common actions from anywhere in the platform.
project.value: Basis spans several roles and functions within adtech, and users managing multiple campaigns found its complex hierarchy painful to navigate. A dynamic global search lets them comb through unstructured data and quickly find what they want, when they need it most.
project.role: I was the UI designer, working very closely with a UX designer, product, and engineering.

next.title: Joint Consumer Experience
next.goal: Bring Tock venues into the Resy consumer experience, increasing their visibility and demand while reducing the overhead of maintaining multiple products and brands.
next.value: Diners get more discovery and dining options, and more value from their Resy credit through the channels they already use. For American Express, a wider network of the best restaurants delivers membership value to existing members and entices new card signups.
next.role: I was a lead designer on the search and availability squad, working on a cross-functional team with product and engineering.
